The incumbent writes press releases, talking points, statements, and newsletters; provides quarterly media training and gives regular, direct feedback to the member of Congress; cultivates and maintains personal relationships with members of the local, state, and national press and strategic partners; manages a social media team; proactively conceptualizes, drafts, pitches, and places op-eds; and books and manages television, digital and print interviews. This position is open to applicants willing to live or relocate to either Washington, DC or the Congressman's district which spans the North Shore and Merrimack Valley in Massachusetts.
